title: research: encoded CRT entry initialization and complete lifecycle
body:
The retained encoded current-child CRT producer starts from a host-initialized arena and P-bit padded descriptors. This package supplies that missing entry/lifecycle boundary from a unary width guide, canonical paired streams and eight protected caller words.

The actual retained producer executes unchanged. Its `bits >= 4` guard reads the encoded guide; 56 owned numerical ports, one template and three record ports are initialized locally. Exact allocator-event correspondence preserves the original lazy allocator's slot order across repeated calls. Consumption and terminal retirement erase all60 owned ports and restore heads. The scoped proof gives all-admitted-width source-operation and retained tape-cell bounds; paired records include all2P+4 framing cells.

Validation: five contexts/ten actual calls at P4/10/16/24, independent CRT endpoint oracle, exact allocation/free coupling, padded/invalid coordinate and right-prefix cases, full borrowed ownership and terminal cleanup. Semantic mutants, genuine guard controls and typed receipt checks pass. Normal and optimized Git-free replays pass from the official export; missing RESULT/SOURCES, source corruption and bool/float receipt corruption reject in real processes. Source-history/export checks pass. Independent peer review ran a different repeated-call fixture and resolved framing-accounting findings before freeze.

This closes the numerical source-operation entry at the retained PR5053 contract, not an upstream descriptor producer, literal binary arithmetic compiler, ROM/raw/repair join, selected supplier or complete multiplication theorem. Successful-domain cleanup is proved; malformed-path rollback is not claimed. No selected or predecessor bytes change.

Claim: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4709#discussioncomment-19145646

Prepared by JoyboyBrian with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0. PR5053 and the retained CRT arithmetic, words and records lineage keep their attribution as pinned in SOURCES.json and the package README.
